rules.title: Egress guard context

check.instructions: In ask_model, copy one contiguous source excerpt containing the backend.filter expression controlled by live, replay and reused, followed by the provider-is-absent/no-mock branch that returns the prepared request without a provider call. This task concerns only that preparation guard. Return exactly one shortest source excerpt in context. Preserve whitespace exactly. Do not use ellipses, join excerpts, reformat or repair code; do not decide compliance.

context.description: One literal contiguous excerpt containing the provider filter and its preparation-only return branch.

rules.falsifier: The excerpt omits or alters the specified preparation guard, joins separate source spans or invents text.

rules.title: TypeSafe response validation context

check.instructions: From the selected decoder and declarations, copy the response identity, answer-set, type, probability and usage validation paths, including refusal branches and field-validation attributes. Return source quotes only; do not decide compliance.

context.description: Exact validation and refusal excerpts from the decoder and response declarations.

rules.falsifier: A controlling validation is omitted or a quote is invented.

rules.title: Terminal accounting context

check.instructions: In scan_bound, copy only the final coupling invocation that checks sink validation and agreement of sink, records and manifest lengths, including its failure message and ? propagation. Return that one invocation as the shortest contiguous source excerpt in context. This task concerns only that final coverage guard. Preserve whitespace exactly. Do not use ellipses, join excerpts, reformat or repair code; do not decide compliance.

context.description: One literal contiguous excerpt of the final sink/records/manifest coverage coupling invocation.

rules.falsifier: The excerpt omits or alters the specified final coverage invocation, joins separate source spans or invents text.

rules.title: Select experimental outcome declarations
rules.falsifier: The captures differ from the complete unresolved and outcome declarations inside scan_bound.

rules.title: Protected publication context

check.instructions: From the complete selected publication and credential functions, copy the protected-input comparison, write, persist and acknowledgment paths with their refusal handling. Return source quotes only; do not decide compliance.

context.description: Exact protected-input and publication success/refusal excerpts.

rules.falsifier: A controlling protected-input or publication path is omitted or a quote is invented.

rules.title: JSON duplicate-key context

check.instructions: From the complete selected parser and visitor, copy the duplicate-key refusal and typed deserialization paths. Return source quotes only; do not decide compliance.

context.description: Exact duplicate-key refusal and typed-deserialization excerpts.

rules.falsifier: A controlling validation path is omitted or a quote is invented.

rules.title: Live opt-in

check.instructions: Does this code send a model request when live evaluation is not enabled?
check.criteria_true: A model request is sent without live opt-in.
check.criteria_false: Model requests are sent only when live evaluation is enabled.

rules.falsifier: A model request is sent without live opt-in.

rules.title: Allowed provider origin

check.instructions: Does this code allow a live model call to an endpoint whose origin the profile's allowed_egress does not permit?
check.criteria_true: It allows a different origin.
check.criteria_false: It rejects a different origin.

rules.falsifier: It allows a different origin.

rules.title: Response model

check.instructions: Does this decoder accept a response naming a model other than the configured one?
check.criteria_true: It accepts a different model name.
check.criteria_false: It rejects a different model name.

rules.title: Requested answer

rules.falsifier: It accepts a missing check ID.

rules.title: Extra answers

check.instructions: Can more than one answer pass this decoder?

check.criteria_false: It requires exactly one answer.

rules.falsifier: It accepts more than one answer.

rules.title: Answer type

rules.falsifier: It does not check that the counts agree.

rules.title: Semantic result
